That file's lemma is private, so it cannot be used here. The injectivity-through-completion argument is therefore proved twice, and the two copies must be kept in sync.

Its signature `(I : Ideal R) [IsAdicComplete I R] {f g} (h : ∀ n, adicReduction I n f = adicReduction I n g) : f = g` is already what is needed here. Then delete the local copy at lines 81–89. The call `apply restricted_eq_of_reductions I` in `restrictedDivision_decomposition` is unchanged. It resolves to `MvPowerSeries.restricted_eq_of_reductions` if `MvPowerSeries` is opened or the name is qualified (`MvPowerSeries.restricted_eq_of_reductions I`).
findings.benefit: This removes a duplicated proof. A future change to the completion equivalence API is fixed in one place. The extensionality principle becomes available to other files, so they will not need a third copy.

findings.excerpt:
obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := MvPolynomial.map_surjective
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (MvPowerSeries.adicReduction I n f)
findings.problem: Both theorems lift the level-n reduction of `f` to a polynomial `p` with `map (mk (I^n)) p = adicReduction I n f`. They then push the extension through that lift with the same three-step rewrite: `adicReduction_restrictedLinearExtension`, `← polynomialLinearMapMod_map`, `hp`. This appears in `hrem` at lines 107–113, in `hrem` at lines 171–175, and in the longer `hquot` calc at lines 121–131. The `hquot` calc re-derives the same fact with `F := (Finsupp.lapply i).comp (m.linearDivisionQuotient b hb)`. Lines 164–166 (`hlevel`) are copied into the second theorem but never used there. The core fact is never stated as a lemma.
findings.proposed_change: Add one general lemma in LinearExtension.lean, or locally here. Statement: for `F : MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R`, `f : adicallyRestrictedSubring I`, `n`, and `p` with `hp : MvPolynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)) p = adicReduction I n f`, we have `adicReduction I n (restrictedLinearExtension I F f) = MvPolynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)) (F p)`. Proof: `rw [adicReduction_restrictedLinearExtension, ← polynomialLinearMapMod_map, hp]`. Optionally add the lifting statement `∃ p, map (mk (I^n)) p = adicReduction I n f`, which is `MvPolynomial.map_surjective ...`. Then `hrem` in both proofs becomes this lemma applied to `F := linearDivisionRemainder b hb`. The `hquot` calc becomes the lemma with `F := (Finsupp.lapply i).comp (m.linearDivisionQuotient b hb)`, followed by `simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lapply_apply]`. The unused `hlevel` is dropped from the second theorem. In the first theorem, `hlevel` is needed only for `rw [← hlevel]`, so it can be stated with `adicReduction_polynomial` directly.
findings.benefit: The 10-line `hquot` calc disappears and the two copies of `hrem` become one-line applications. The role of the lifted polynomial `p` is stated once, so each theorem reads as its mathematical content: the decomposition at level n, and the vanishing coefficient. Maintenance is also easier, because a change to `restrictedLinearExtension` or the level-map API is fixed in one lemma.
